items.kind: Label update (label has a boxed warning)
items.name: Levonorgestrel and Ethinyl Estradiol
items.facts: Updated label for Levonorgestrel and Ethinyl Estradiol (Apotex Corp.). Boxed warning: WARNING: CIGARETTE SMOKING AND SERIOUS CARDIOVASCULAR EVENTS Cigarette smoking increases the risk of serious cardiovascular events from combination oral contraceptive (COC) use. This risk increases with age, particularly in women over 35 years of age, and with the number of cigarettes smoked. For this reason, COCs, including levonorgestrel and ethinyl estradiol tablets, are contraindicated in women who are over 35 years of age and smoke [see CONTRAINDICATIONS and WARNINGS (1) ].
items.summary: The label for Apotex Corp.'s levonorgestrel and ethinyl estradiol was updated; its boxed warning covers cigarette smoking and serious cardiovascular events.

items.name: ketorolac tromethamine
items.facts: Updated label for ketorolac tromethamine (Sportpharm LLC). Boxed warning: WARNING Ketorolac tromethamine, a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID), is indicated for the short-term (up to 5 days in adults) management of moderately severe acute pain that requires analgesia at the opioid level. Oral ketorolac tromethamine is indicated only as continuation treatment following intravenous or intramuscular dosing of ketorolac tromethamine, if necessary.
